# react-native-platform-components

> Native TextField, DatePicker, ContextMenu, SelectionMenu, SegmentedControl, TabBar, NavigationRail, Button, ButtonGroup, FloatingToolbar and LiquidGlass for React Native. Every component is the real platform widget on both iOS (UIKit / SwiftUI) and Android (Material 3), behind one typed, declarative API. No JavaScript re-implementations. New Architecture (Fabric + Codegen) only. TypeScript types included. Expo config plugin included.

Install: `npm install react-native-platform-components`. iOS: `cd ios && pod install`. Android: nothing to configure; give the app a Material 3 theme to use your colors (the components fall back to Material 3 defaults otherwise). Expo: dev client or EAS Build (not Expo Go); add `["react-native-platform-components/app.plugin", { "android": { "theme": "material3" } }]` to `expo.plugins`, then `npx expo prebuild`.

Requirements: React Native 0.81+ with the New Architecture, Expo SDK 54+, React 19, iOS 13+ (LiquidGlass needs iOS 26), Android API 24+.

Platform-only props live under `ios={{ ... }}` and `android={{ ... }}` on every component.

## Components

- [TextField](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/textfield): `TextInputLayout` (Material 3 outlined or filled) on Android; `UITextField` / growing `UITextView` on iOS. `TextInput`-compatible `value`, `onChangeText`, `placeholder`, `secureTextEntry`, `keyboardType`, `maxLength`, `editable`, ref `focus()` / `blur()` / `clear()`; plus `label`, `supportingText`, `error`, `prefix`, `suffix`, `leadingIcon`, `trailingIcon`, `clearButtonMode`, `passwordToggle`, `showCharacterCount`, `multiline`, `autoComplete`; `ios.writingTools`, `ios.inlinePrediction`, `ios.smartQuotes`, `ios.smartDashes`, `ios.mathExpressionCompletion`, `ios.borderStyle`, `ios.labelPlacement` (`above` | `leading`, the Contacts form row), `ios.labelWidth`; `android.material` (`m3` | `system`, the Material field or the platform EditText), `android.variant` (`outlined` | `filled`), `android.dense`.
- [DatePicker](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/datepicker): `UIDatePicker` on iOS; `MaterialDatePicker` / `MaterialTimePicker` (`android.material: 'm3'`) or AppCompat dialogs (`'system'`) on Android. Props: `date`, `mode` (`date` | `time` | `dateAndTime` | `countDownTimer`), `presentation` (`modal` | `embedded`), `visible`, `minDate`, `maxDate`, `locale`, `timeZoneName`, `onConfirm`, `onClosed`.
- [ContextMenu](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/contextmenu): `UIContextMenuInteraction` on iOS; `PopupMenu` on Android. Long-press gesture mode or modal mode, actions with icons (SF Symbols on iOS, drawables or images on Android), `onSelect`.
- [SelectionMenu](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/selectionmenu): system menus on iOS; Material exposed dropdown (`m3`) or `Spinner` (`system`) on Android. Headless (anchored to your own view) or inline modes, `options`, `selected`, `onSelect`.
- [SegmentedControl](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/segmentedcontrol): `UISegmentedControl` on iOS; `MaterialButtonToggleGroup` (Material 3 segmented buttons) on Android. `segments` (label, value, icon, badge, disabled), `selectedValue`, `onSelect`, label visibility, per-platform styling.
- [TabBar](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/tabbar): `UITabBar` on iOS (the floating Liquid Glass bar on iOS 26); `BottomNavigationView` (Material 3 navigation bar) on Android. `items` (label, value, icon, selectedIcon, badge, disabled, testID), `selectedValue`, `onSelect`, `onReselect`, `labelVisibility`, colors, `barColor`.
- [NavigationRail](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/navigationrail): `NavigationRailView` (Material 3 Expressive) on Android; on iOS, which has no rail, a column of tab-style `UIButton`s. The TabBar item model (label, value, icon, selectedIcon, badge, disabled, testID), `selectedValue`, `onSelect`, `onReselect`, `header` (React content in the rail's header slot), `menuGravity` (`top` | `center` | `bottom`), `expanded` (the expanded rail), `labelVisibility`, colors, `railColor`. Takes its natural width; the app gives it its height.
- [LiquidGlass](https://jarx-concepts.github.io/react-native-platform-components/components/liquidglass): `UIGlassEffect` on iOS 26+; plain `View` with `android.fallbackBackgroundColor` elsewhere. `cornerRadius`, `ios.effect` (`regular` | `clear` | `none`), `ios.interactive`, `ios.tintColor`, `ios.colorScheme`; `isLiquidGlassSupported` constant.
